itemName: Konaseema Goat Fry Biryani Family Pack
description: Indulge in our Konaseema Goat Fry Biryani Family Pack, featuring tender, marinated goat meat sautéed with aromatic spices, layered with fragrant basmati rice. Each bite bursts with a harmonious blend of saffron, cardamom, and herbs, making it a perfect feast for the whole family.
